name: marker-type
description: Select markers based on their type (-2: unbulked for IMZ growth, -1: unbulked for collapse, 0: unbulked for rilling, 1: partially bulked, 2: fully bulked, 3: air)
notes: MassFlow-specific. The manual defines five type codes (-2 unbulked for IMZ growth, -1 unbulked for collapse, 0 unbulked for rilling, 1 partially bulked, 2 fully bulked) but the engine accepts integers between -2 and 3.
Used by the vendor's own unittests.dat: `massflow marker list range marker-type 2`.
official_documentation: Itasca 9.7 shared kernel manual: Range Phrase Keyword Reference
